metric_definitions.state_definition: state at step t := observation_before[t] (the environment text the agent saw when it chose action[t]), string-equal after .strip()
metric_definitions.action_repetition_ratio: 1 - |unique actions| / T ; T = number of environment actions
metric_definitions.max_consecutive_same_action: max run-length of identical consecutive actions
metric_definitions.max_consecutive_same_observation: max run-length of identical observation_after strings
metric_definitions.state_action_pair_repeat_count: NUMBER OF DISTINCT (state, action) pairs whose occurrence count >= 2. This is a count of pair TYPES, not of extra occurrences.
metric_definitions.state_action_loop_occurrences: EXTRA occurrences beyond the first of every repeated (state, action) pair = sum_{p: count(p)>1} (count(p) - 1). This is an occurrence count, not a type count.
metric_definitions.no_new_info_action_ratio: fraction of steps t where observation_after[t] == observation_before[t] (denominator T)
metric_definitions.obs_change_after_action_ratio: fraction of consecutive comparison slots where observation_after[t] != observation_after[t-1]. Denominator is T-1 (pairs of consecutive steps), numerator is the number of those pairs that differ. Undefined for T<2.
metric_definitions.unique_location_visit_count: number of distinct ALFWorld location tokens seen in environment feedback or targeted by 'go to' actions
metric_definitions.half_behavior_divergence: 1 - Jaccard(action SET of first half, action SET of second half); 0 = identical action sets
